composition.quality_review: Sharper wall and glass detail than the 512 GAN; all five prescribed openings retained. Mirrored repetition, dark mortar and image-based glass remain visible limitations; not a claim of general photorealism.

scope: One CMP validation pilot run; no new held-out benchmark or four-style training claim
